title: acer dasycarpum subvar. normale
intro: Acer dasycarpum subvar. normale, commonly known as the Chinese paperbark maple, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Acer dasycarpum subvar. normale include immune system support, anti-cancer properties, and cardiovascular protection, although further research is needed to confirm these effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
